column1: # Machine-readable copy of WORKFLOW.md's type-aware phase matrix.
# Whitespace-separated (parse with the default awk FS). Cell values:
#   yes      phase runs
#   skip     phase is skipped for this type  (drives the scenario forbid rules)
#   light    thinner pass
#   opt      optional / discretionary
#   trigger  runs only when the security trigger fires
# run-doc-consistency.sh keeps the load-bearing skip cells (test-plan / test /
# security) in sync with WORKFLOW.md; run-scenario-tests.sh reads the columns to
# derive which artifacts a given type's run must NOT contain. Change a skip->yes
# here (and in WORKFLOW.md) and the matching fixture fails until its artifact set
# is updated — the matrix is executable, not just prose.
# The first non-comment row is the header (column names); the awk parsers key off
# it, so it must stay uncommented.
phase         feat     fix      refactor chore    docs     spike
interview     yes      yes      yes      yes      yes      yes
plan          yes      yes      yes      yes      yes      yes
test-plan     yes      yes      yes      skip     skip     skip
gate          yes      yes      yes      yes      yes      yes
implement     yes      yes      yes      yes      yes      yes
test          yes      yes      yes      skip     skip     skip
review        yes      yes      yes      yes      yes      light
security      trigger  trigger  trigger  trigger  trigger  skip
docs          yes      opt      opt      opt      yes      skip
ship          yes      yes      yes      yes      yes      yes
retro         yes      yes      yes      yes      yes      yes
